lib/presenters/visit_summary.rb.after:
# frozen_string_literal: true
module Presenters
  class VisitSummary
    def self.print(page)
      puts "#{page.path}: #{page.visits_count} visits"
    end
  end
end

spec/tests/reviewer_feature_spec.rb.after:
# frozen_string_literal: true
require_relative '../../lib/path_tracker/page'
require_relative '../../lib/presenters/visit_summary'
RSpec.describe Presenters::VisitSummary do
  it 'prints the count' do
    page = PathTracker::Page.new('/home')
    page.add_visit('127.0.0.1')
    expect { described_class.print(page) }.to output("/home: 1 visits\n").to_stdout
  end
end
